name: open_meta_values
query: SELECT DISTINCT account, open_meta(account, 'institution') AS institution, open_meta(account, 'number') AS number, open_meta(account, 'account') AS account_number, open_meta(account, 'nope') AS missing WHERE account ~ '^Assets:US:(BofA|Vanguard)' ORDER BY account
notes: open_meta(account, key) is a metadata value of the account's open directive, NULL when absent. Metadata is not inherited: Assets:US:BofA:Checking has no institution although Assets:US:BofA has. beanquery's one-argument open_meta(account) is a dict with filename and lineno, which zhang does not keep, so it is not covered.
